notes: Dockerfile.final uses condaforge/mambaforge:latest base image with conda pre-installed at /opt/conda. Simplified setup: removed bioconda-utils and mamba to avoid dependency conflicts. Uses gcc/gxx from conda-forge with channel_priority flexible. Dockerfile correctly copies setup scripts to /opt/benchmark/, runs repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace, then runs setup_runtime.sh to create the bioconda environment. WORKDIR is set to /workspace. No apt-get commands in Dockerfile - all package management uses conda.
